abstract.p: Presented are methods and compositions for using immobilized CRISPR/Cas9 enzymes for generating an immobilized library of randomly fragmented, double-stranded target nucleic acid fragments on a surface. The methods are useful for generating nucleic acid fragments for use in a variety of processes, including massively parallel nucleic acid sequencing.
